basics.name: Xavier Saliniere
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Web Developer
basics.summary: Senior Full-Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience building enterprise security and analytics applications. At Bell Canada's Operations Center, I developed platforms for WAF management, vulnerability tracking, phishing detection, and customer service analytics — including an AI conversational agent with chart visualization capabilities enabling natural language querying over millions of interaction records. Currently studying cybersecurity and penetration testing as part of a planned career transition into offensive security.

work.name: Bell Canada
work.summary: Full-stack development for Bell Canada's Operations Center through Talan contracting, building enterprise security and analytics platforms.
highlights: Built INSIGHTS Agent from scratch — AI conversational agent (Google ADK + Gemini) with rich response rendering including inline charts and data visualizations; enables natural language querying over Bell's customer service interaction database; sole developer across architecture, tool design, API integration, and deployment

Delivered INSIGHTS Platform end-to-end (Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia) — shipped Trending Themes with year-over-year analysis, interactive treemap visualization, MongoDB caching optimization, Playwright E2E test suite, and AI chatbot integration; platform serves 1,100+ users
Designed BFF-specific RBAC permission model (Spring Boot + Keycloak) for INSIGHTS, defining all role/scope/AD group mappings; sole owner of the permission layer across the service

Built WAF Management UI (Vue 3 + Vite + Element Plus + Tailwind CSS) — architected Composable-First pattern for localized state management, built multi-step ASM Signature wizard, and real-time device monitoring

Developed Vulnerability Management platform (Vue 2 + TypeScript) — built Containment Feature for mitigation tracking, Priority 1 workflow for critical vulnerability handling, Welcome Tour onboarding, and redesigned approval bundle workflow with file attachment support

Built Phisherman anti-phishing platform (Vue 3 + Module Federation) — developed SOC analyst dashboard with submission statistics, top phishing domain visualizations, and UI for URLScan.io, Symantec Threat Explorer, and Wildfire threat intelligence feeds

Developed UCDB-UI cybersecurity use case platform (Vue 3 + Pinia + Vue I18n) — built comprehensive filter system with URL query sync, KPI-driven dashboard with customizable columns, and Dark Mode implementation
Contributed to EDR and SLURP security platforms (Vue 2) — designed Core Filter System Architecture with saved filter sets, UI for SentinelOne security audit trails, and barcode asset tracking
